    **Solution:** You need to change your directory to `scratch` first before running the command:
    ```powershell
    cd scratch
    npm.cmd run dev
    ```

2.  **`File C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system`**:
    When you ran `npm run dev`, Windows PowerShell blocked it due to its strict execution policy, which prevents running unsigned scripts by default.
    **Solution:** You can bypass this by continuing to use `npm.cmd` (which runs the batch file instead of the PowerShell script) like you did in your first attempt:
    ```powershell
    cd scratch
    npm.cmd run dev
    ```
    Alternatively, if you want to fix the PowerShell script execution policy permanently so `npm run dev` works, you can run PowerShell as Administrator and run:
    ```powershell
    Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
    ```

Try running `cd scratch` followed by `npm.cmd run dev` and your development server should start successfully!
